groups.description: The company this domain is modeled on: Health Cloud Initiative (HCI), the Dutch healthcare software group backed by Vortex Capital Partners since the 2021 buyout with founder Eric de Boer, built through more than 14 add-on acquisitions.

links.title: Health Cloud Initiative — more time for care through more ease
links.relevance: The group's own proposition: 40,000+ healthcare professionals every day, 4 million+ patients, NEN 7510 and ISO 27001 certification, and the partner ecosystem (DigiDoc, HC, QUIN, ProMedico, Pharmapartners, MicroHIS, Fysio AI, PhysioTrack, Vecozo) behind every persona.

links.title: Health Cloud Initiative — Vortex investment page
links.relevance: The investor's description of the 2021 buyout with founder Eric de Boer and the buy-and-build programme of more than 14 add-on acquisitions — the strategy the consolidation horizons are modeled on.

links.title: Vortex Capital Partners investeert in Health Cloud Initiative (June 2022)
links.relevance: The 2022 announcement with the 7,500+ professionals, €500 million+ annual declarations, 45+ team members and 2 million+ patients baseline, and the ambition of relieving 20,000 professionals of administrative burden.

links.title: Robin Dunki Jacobs appointed as new CEO of HCI (May 2025)
links.relevance: The CEO change that sets the current mandate: integrate the acquired labels, expand digital patient access through a unified network and invest in digital triage, AI and e-health.

groups.description: The public product pages that the products, deployment channels and product bricks are modeled on: HCI One and the paramedical labels, CRS for GGZ, the patient environments and the e-health platform.

links.title: HCI One — the new multidisciplinary paramedical platform
links.relevance: The consolidation target built on the FysioRoadmap web foundation for FysioRoadmap, SpotOnMedics, Incura, Evry, Abakus, Podofile, Edevop and FysioLogic, rolled out per discipline with no forced migration — the onboard-migrate-and-consolidate stream.

links.title: Fysiotherapie — HCI software for physiotherapy practices
links.relevance: How HCI positions its physiotherapy labels (FysioRoadmap, SpotOnMedics, Incura, HCI One) to practice owners — the agenda, dossier, declaration and patient-app promise of the Physiotherapy Practice Owner persona.

links.title: SpotOnMedics — functies
links.relevance: 24/7 online booking synchronised with the agenda, mobile agenda, BI tooling, Mollie payments, billing services and group management — the feature set behind the scheduling, payments and management-insight bricks.

links.title: HCI CRS — all-in-one EPD for GGZ and youth care
links.relevance: Dossiers, treatment plans, medication, agenda, declarations, central client portal, SmartAI voice-to-text and reporting, with integrations to Embloom, Bergop, Therapieland, ZorgDomein, ZorgMail and Minddistrict — the GGZ EPD bricks.

links.title: EPD-leveranciers — HCI's EPD portfolio overview
links.relevance: The overview of HCI's EPD labels across paramedical and mental health care — the label landscape the implementation consultant migrates and the integration partner connects to.

links.title: Uw Zorg Online — the digital front door
links.relevance: E-consult, records, medication and repeat prescriptions, self-measurements, appointment booking in the practice agenda and triage, connected to Sanday, HealthConnected, Pharmapartners, CGM, Bricks and Vertimart, MedMij-certified, 3 million+ app users.

links.title: Praktijkwebsites — practice websites with online booking and portal entry
links.relevance: The Praktijkinfo website portfolio under Uw Zorg Online: practice websites with online booking, e-consult and triage entry points — the publish-and-run-a-practice-website stream and the GP Practice and Pharmacy Manager's findability job.

links.title: Quli — personal health environment and network care
links.relevance: The MedMij-labelled PGO for GGZ clients and their network: data retrieval, granular sharing with family and informal carers, diary and single login for e-health apps — the Quli bricks and the Patient and Client persona's sharing job.

links.title: Embloom — questionnaires and e-health interventions integrated in the EPD
links.relevance: 500+ questionnaires and 450 e-health interventions fully integrated in the EPD for hybrid GGZ and somatic care — the questionnaire library and blended-care bricks.

groups.description: The standards and registers every paramedical and GGZ practice must comply with, which the declaration engine, ROM and quality-data bricks are built around.

links.title: Vecozo haalt oude declaratiestandaard per 1 januari 2025 uit de lucht (LVVP)
links.relevance: The GDS801 cut-over: treatments from 1 January 2025 must be declared in GDS801 while PM304 stays for 2024 treatment dates — the dual-standard routing rule of the declaration engine.

links.title: Vektis — PM304 3.2 paramedical declaration standard
links.relevance: The retired PM304 standard that still governs corrections on 2024 episodes — the tail the declaration engine must keep supporting after the GDS801 switch.

links.title: Zorgprestatiemodel — the GGZ and forensic care financing model
links.relevance: The official site of the zorgprestatiemodel with consults, settings and professional standards that the GGZ registration and compliance brick implements for practitioners and institutions.

links.title: Zorgprestatiemodel: nieuwe veldafspraken 2026 (LVVP)
links.relevance: The 2026 field agreements: a mandatory referral date on every declaration, the system therapist added to the professional standards and the end of the transitional benefit — the yearly compliance release train.

links.title: Koppelen EPD aan de LDF (KNGF)
links.relevance: How an EPD is connected to the Landelijke Database Fysiotherapie: monthly pseudonymised delivery, explicit patient consent and the Keurmerk requirement — the consent-gated quality-data pipeline the physiotherapy practice owner depends on.

groups.description: The obligations and infrastructure for digital data exchange with patients that the Uw Zorg Online and Quli bricks must satisfy.

links.title: MedMij — veelgestelde vragen zorgaanbieders
links.relevance: MedMij's answers for care providers on Wegiz (April 2023), PGO connections, the share of GGZ institutions already connected and the exploratory status of paramedical care — the compliance context of the MedMij data exchange brick.

links.title: MedMij register — labelled PGOs and care providers
links.relevance: The official register of MedMij-labelled personal health environments and connected care providers — the PGO landscape (16 labelled PGOs in November 2025) in which Uw Zorg Online and Quli compete for the patient's choice.

groups.description: Statistics on the first-line physiotherapy and GGZ markets and the vendors HCI competes with for practices and institutions.

links.title: Nivel — cijfers zorg die de fysiotherapeut verleent (2024)
links.relevance: Nivel's 2024 registration network: 7,848 physiotherapists in 543 participating practices treating 1,162,545 patients — a national sample that anchors the physiotherapy persona (practice sizes, patient volumes), not a count of the whole sector.

links.title: Regiomonitor: wachttijden ggz onverminderd lang (LVVP)
links.relevance: GGZ waiting times above the 14-week Treeknorm in all regions in the first half of 2025 — the intake and waiting-list pressure of the independent GGZ practitioner.

links.title: EPD-inventarisatie GGZ 2025: Nedap nadert marktleider (M&I/Partners)
links.relevance: The EPD and client-portal shares of the 50 largest GGZ organisations by revenue — SDB Groep 30%, Nedap 27%, PinkRoccade 14%, Adapcare 12%, Nexus 10%; Caren and Karify 22.5% each, Quli 4% — the institutional competition context.

links.title: Intramed — practice software for paramedics and GGZ
links.relevance: The largest paramedical practice-software competitor (a calculated 53% share of physiotherapy practices in a 2017 Marktdata survey) with its own patient app, Fysio.AI and financial services — the benchmark for HCI One.
